beginner.headline: Celine Dion's Surprise Performance at Paris Fashion Week
beginner.brief: Celine Dion opened Paris Fashion Week. She gave a surprise performance. She sang at a show for L'Oreal. Celine Dion is a famous Canadian singer. Other famous people like Viola Davis joined her on the runway. Paris Fashion Week shows new clothes and designs. Many big fashion brands show their collections there.

intermediate.headline: Celine Dion Starts Paris Fashion Week with Surprise Performance
intermediate.brief: Celine Dion has opened Paris Fashion Week with a performance of her 2002 hit I'm Alive. This event took place underneath the city's famous Eiffel Tower. The singer appeared at the end of L'Oreal's annual show. The Canadian star, who was diagnosed with a rare neurological disease called stiff person syndrome in 2022, took to the runway. She wore a ruched full-length velvet black gown for the occasion. Famous ambassadors for the French brand, including Viola Davis and Eva Longoria, later joined her. Dion recently performed a comeback show in the city earlier this month. This was her first since her 2020 concert, which was cut short by the Covid pandemic. Paris Fashion Week is currently showcasing women's spring/summer collections. The event runs until 6 October. The fashion world is keeping a close eye on Dior and Chanel. Both brands signed up new artistic directors last year.

advanced.headline: Celine Dion and High Fashion Kick Off Paris Week
advanced.brief: Celine Dion kicks off Paris Fashion Week with surprise performance. The singer appeared at the end of L'Oreal's annual show as the French fashion bonanza kicked off. Celine Dion has opened Paris Fashion Week with a surprise performance of her 2002 hit I'm Alive, underneath the city's famous Eiffel Tower. The Canadian star, who was diagnosed with a rare neurological disease called stiff person syndrome in 2022, took to the runway at the end of L'Oreal's annual show. The singer, who wore a ruched full-length velvet black gown, was later joined by famous ambassadors for the French brand, including Viola Davis, Simone Ashley, Aja Naomi King and Eva Longoria. Dion recently performed a comeback show in the city earlier this month, her first since her 2020 concert in New Jersey - the last before the Covid pandemic cut her tour short. Kendall Jenner also modelled at the show, wearing a sheer black halterneck dress with thigh split and an ivory corset underneath. Pop star Rihanna brought her usual fashion credentials to Paris on day one, with a shimmering, glamorous copper two-piece worn over sheer black lingerie. The fashion world is keeping a particularly close eye on Dior and Chanel, after both signed up new artistic directors last year. This week should see the pair continue to solidify their strategies for the two brands. Expect some serious aesthetic rivalry on the runways.
